- For each test case, output a line containing "yes" or "no" (without quotes) corresponding to the case if the array is rainbow array or not.

- 1 ≤ T ≤ 100
- 7 ≤ N ≤ 100
- 1 ≤ Ai ≤ 10

- Subtask 1 (100 points) : Original constraints
